title: The Disney Afternoon
intro: [excited] Grab a juice box and a snack, it's The Disney Afternoon! Tonight's board is all about Disney's animated TV shows, from DuckTales to Gravity Falls. [laughs] Homework can wait. This is IMPORTANT.

art.prompt: A cozy 1990s living room after school: a chunky CRT television glowing with colorful light, a beanbag chair, a backpack tossed on the floor, juice boxes and a bowl of cereal on the carpet, sunshine through the window, 16:9 widescreen, vibrant cinematic lighting, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

categories.title: Life Is Like a Hurricane
categories.intro: Our first category is Life Is Like a Hurricane, all about DuckTales! [excited] Woo-oo! Sorry, it's the law. You have to say it.

art.prompt: A towering money bin vault on a hill overlooking a cartoon harbor city, gold coins spilling out of the top, a diving board over a sea of coins, a sunset sky, 16:9 widescreen, vibrant cinematic lighting, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

clues.clue: Scrooge McDuck's three grandnephews are Huey, Dewey and this duck.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Louie! [laughs] Red, blue and green. In the 2017 series they finally got their own personalities.

clues.clue: Scrooge McDuck keeps his fortune in this giant building, and even dives into it like a swimming pool.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Money Bin! [chuckles] Please, do not try diving into your piggy bank at home.

clues.clue: This crash-prone pilot flies Scrooge around the world, and crashes almost every landing.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Launchpad McQuack! [laughs] He later became Darkwing Duck's sidekick. Any landing you can walk away from, right?

clues.clue: This sorceress keeps trying to steal Scrooge's lucky Number One Dime.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Magica De Spell! [mischievously] She wants to melt it into a magic amulet. Scrooge would rather melt first.

clues.clue: In the 1987 DuckTales, Scrooge's loyal English butler is named this.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Duckworth! [chuckles] Prim, proper and always unimpressed. Mrs. Beakley ran the house, too.

categories.title: After-School Special
categories.intro: Next up, After-School Special! The shows that ruled our afternoons. [excited] Prepare for some serious nostalgia.

art.prompt: A colorful collage of afternoon TV adventure: a cargo seaplane over a tropical harbor, stone statues on a Manhattan skyscraper, a detective agency treehouse and a cape fluttering on a bridge at night, 16:9 widescreen, vibrant cinematic lighting, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

clues.clue: In Goof Troop, Goofy is a single dad raising his son, named this.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Max! [laughs] He grew up to star in A Goofy Movie. Ah-hyuck!

clues.clue: In TaleSpin, this Jungle Book bear flies a cargo seaplane called the Sea Duck.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Baloo! [chuckles] From bare necessities to cargo deliveries. Still pretty relaxed about deadlines.

clues.clue: This caped mallard introduces himself as the terror that flaps in the night.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Darkwing Duck! [dramatic pause] Let's get dangerous! The most dramatic duck in Saint Canard.

clues.clue: In Gargoyles, the clan's winged leader, who turns to stone by day, is named this.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Goliath! [whispers] Asleep for a thousand years, then awakened in Manhattan. That's one long nap.

clues.clue: The two-hour weekday block known as The Disney Afternoon premiered in syndication in this year.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is 1990! [excited] DuckTales, Rescue Rangers, Gummi Bears and TaleSpin, all in one afternoon. Peak childhood.

categories.title: After-School Zoom
categories.intro: It's our zoom category, After-School Zoom! The picture starts super close and slowly pulls back. [excited] Name that TV show!

clues.clue: This zoomed-in scene sets the stage for which Disney animated TV series?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Phineas and Ferb! [laughs] A giant backyard roller coaster, built in one afternoon. Mom will NEVER see it.

categories.title: Toons in the Parks
categories.intro: Time for the parks: Toons in the Parks! [mischievously] Our TV pals don't just stay on TV, you know.

art.prompt: A whimsical cartoon town in a theme park with crooked candy-colored buildings, a tiny acorn-shaped coaster car on a twisting wooden track and a spy gadget glowing in a World Showcase plaza, 16:9 widescreen, vibrant cinematic lighting, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

clues.clue: Mickey's Toontown opened in 1993 at this original Disney park.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Disneyland! [excited] A whole cartoon town where nothing is straight. Not even the lampposts.

clues.clue: Disneyland's Toontown kiddie coaster, rethemed in 2023, is now named after this Rescue Rangers duo.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Chip 'n' Dale! [laughs] It's Chip 'n' Dale's GADGETcoaster now. Gadget built it, but the chipmunks got top billing.

clues.clue: In EPCOT's World Showcase, guests once played a secret agent game helping this Phineas and Ferb platypus.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Perry the Platypus! [chuckles] Agent P's World Showcase Adventure ran from 2012 to 2020. Curse you, Perry the Platypus!

clues.clue: That Perry game replaced a 2009 World Showcase spy game starring this teen hero.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Kim Possible! [excited] Call me, beep me, if you want to reach me. Mission accomplished.

clues.clue: In 2022, that World Showcase game was rethemed yet again, this time to this series rebooted in 2017.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is DuckTales! [laughs] Three games, one World Showcase. Even the spy games get remakes.

categories.title: Theme Song Sing-Along
categories.intro: Our fan category is Theme Song Sing-Along! Finish the theme songs we all sang in the living room. [laughs] Neighbors, I apologize in advance.

art.prompt: Musical notes bursting out of a glowing old CRT television in a dark room, a microphone made from a hairbrush, cartoon starbursts in the air, 16:9 widescreen, vibrant cinematic lighting, original artwork, no text, no logos, no characters, no people

clues.clue: Finish the theme song lyric: There's a hundred and four days of summer vacation, and school comes along just to... it.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is end! [laughs] Phineas and Ferb then spend all hundred and four days building rockets. Overachievers.

clues.clue: Finish the theme song lyric: Life is like a hurricane, here in...
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Duckburg! [excited] Race cars, lasers, aeroplanes... it's a duck blur! Woo-oo!

clues.clue: Finish the theme song lyric: Sometimes some crimes go slippin' through the cracks, but these two gumshoes are pickin' up the...
clues.reveal: The correct answer is slack! [chuckles] Chip 'n Dale Rescue Rangers! No case is too big, no case is too small.

clues.clue: Finish the theme song lyric: Darkwing Duck! When there's trouble, you call...
clues.reveal: The correct answer is D.W.! [dramatic pause] Let's get dangerous. He'd want me to say that.

clues.clue: Finish the theme song lyric: Dashing and daring, courageous and caring, faithful and friendly, with stories to...
clues.reveal: The correct answer is share! [excited] They're the Gummi Bears! Bouncing here and there and everywhere, since 1985.
